rule: Owner decision on #232 (2026-10-07), recorded in docs/decisions.md under Accessibility and localization as a deliberate exception to German as a release-blocking locale: the dive computer reads English in every locale, its warnings included, as legacy draws its dive computer (src/renderer.js drawDiveComputer) in English in both languages.
change: src/app/i18n/catalog.ts moves the 69 dive-computer strings (HUD readouts, stop row, thirds gauge, alert and status-chip warnings, gas-information pages) out of the per-locale tables into a diveComputer.* namespace with no German table, read through diveComputerText(key); DIVE_COMPUTER_LOCALE = 'en' formats their numbers. src/app/wreck-app.ts and src/app/gas-info.ts use them, and set lang=en on the HUD list, the alert, the chip while it warns and the gas-information panel; the location row keeps the page's lang. docs/baseline/claims-register.json points at the new keys.
